from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LongTermEquityInvestment(BaseModel):
    """One company's long-term equity investment from a financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="公司名称，从文档中提取")
    investment_amount: float | None = Field(description="长期股权投资期末余额数值")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="货币单位，如'元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="财务报表期间，如'2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="财务报告中关于长期股权投资的原文描述")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    long_term_equity_investments: list[LongTermEquityInvestment]
